title: X Feed Digest
summary: AI Talent Exodus: Major departures at xAI (Co-founders Jimmy Ba, Tony Wu) and Anthropic (Safety Lead) signal growing internal tensions over safety vs. speed.
Model Wars Heating Up: Karpathy drops a 243-line GPT "art project", while China's GLM-5 enters the arena with aggressive pricing, and Anthropic aggressively expands its free tier.
The "Intelligence Explosion": Viral discussions (Matt Shumer) suggest we've crossed a critical threshold where AI is now effectively building the next generation of AI.
Infrastructure Shifts: AI companies are pledging to fund power grid upgrades to stave off regulation, while edge computing (Fastly/Cloudflare) becomes the new battleground.

items.title: @karpathy: GPT in 243 Lines
items.body: Andrej Karpathy released a "new art project": a full GPT training and inference implementation in just 243 lines of dependency-free Python.

items.title: @SawyerMerritt: xAI Shakeup
items.body: Elon Musk announced a new organizational structure for xAI, confirming the departure of key figures like Jimmy Ba and Tony Wu as the company moves from "early stage" research to execution.

items.title: @dotey: The Intelligence Explosion
items.body: A deep dive into Matt Shumer's viral essay arguing that with GPT-5.3 and Opus 4.6, we have crossed a threshold where AI is now capable of independent, high-level knowledge work.

items.title: @bridgemindai: GLM-5 Drops
items.body: China's Zhipu AI released GLM-5, a massive context model that significantly undercuts OpenAI and Anthropic on price ($0.80/1M input tokens).

items.title: @aakashgupta: Anthropic's Free Tier Play
items.body: Anthropic is aggressively adding features (file creation, skills) to its free tier to capture users just as OpenAI introduces ads to ChatGPT.

items.title: @Hartdrawss: Building Claude Skills
items.body: A breakdown of Anthropic's new 32-page guide on creating "Skills" for Claude to automate recurring workflows.

items.title: @ModernDad: AI Voice Scams
items.body: A chilling personal account of an AI voice spoofing scam mimicking a spouse in an emergency. Advice: establish a family "safe word".

items.title: @aakashgupta: AI & Power Grid
items.body: Major AI companies (Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic) are pledging to pay 100% of new power generation costs, likely a preemptive move to avoid strict government regulation.

items.title: @ReyezAriel: Fastly & Edge Cloud
items.body: Fastly's earnings beat signals a structural shift from traditional CDNs to "Edge Cloud" compute, driven by AI inference needs.

items.title: @yvessirae: The Strawberry Test
items.body: A viral, wholesome story about a husband who pretended to hate strawberries for years just so his wife could have his share.

items.title: @HannahIamthest1: Engineer in Hell
items.body: A classic joke about an engineer fixing up Hell's infrastructure, much to the Devil's delight and God's annoyance.
